detail.longDescription: # HermesAgent users, what's your favorite app for talking to your agent on # Windows or # iOS , particularly if you're # blind , though I'm curious what others use as well. I just migrated my agent from running in WSL to running directly on Windows, so I'm now using Hermes Desktop. I'm not sure I like it in terms of # accessibility . It needs more headings, some buttons labeled, things like that, and its sound notifications are so quiet I don't hear them. I've tried a couple other apps, and my favorite so far is probably https:// github.com/nesquena/hermes-web ui . On iOS, I like Hermes Conduit ( https:// apps.apple.com/us/app/hermes-c onduit/id6790977764 ), though I admit that I haven't played with too many others. The only thing I don't like is that getting the dashboard up and running with basic auth, which this requires, can be tricky. # AI # ScreenReader # AIAgents
